deliverables.semantic_version_rule: A semantic identifier changes major version when applicability, effective input meaning, unit/sign convention, required checks or outcome meaning changes.

foundation_operations.purpose: Calculate nominal circular bar area without selecting reinforcement.
foundation_operations.valid_example: diameter 16 mm returns an unrounded area in mm2 with effective input
foundation_operations.non_success_example: zero diameter returns rejected_input and INPUT.RANGE

foundation_operations.purpose: Calculate reinforcement mass per length from diameter and declared density.
foundation_operations.valid_example: diameter 16 mm and density 7850 kg/m3 returns kg/m
foundation_operations.non_success_example: absent density with no profile returns rejected_input and INPUT.REQUIRED

foundation_operations.purpose: Resolve effective depth from actual bar coordinates and compression face.
foundation_operations.valid_example: two tension layers return area-weighted centroid and effective depth
foundation_operations.non_success_example: unresolved physical face returns rejected_input and AXIS.UNRESOLVED

foundation_operations.purpose: Calculate declared-profile flexural capacity without deciding a demand check or selecting steel.
foundation_operations.valid_example: eligible rectangular section returns capacity, neutral-axis state and rule provenance
foundation_operations.non_success_example: unsupported axial interaction returns completed, not_applicable and PROFILE.UNSUPPORTED

foundation_operations.purpose: Calculate declared-profile shear capacities for supplied longitudinal and transverse steel.
foundation_operations.valid_example: valid section and actual links return concrete, steel and limiting capacities
foundation_operations.non_success_example: missing actual link provision for a provided-capacity request returns rejected_input

foundation_operations.purpose: Calculate required development length for explicit bar, stress state, bond condition and material grades.
foundation_operations.valid_example: tension deformed bar returns required length and all modifiers
foundation_operations.non_success_example: blank bond condition returns rejected_input rather than assuming tension

foundation_operations.purpose: Resolve the applicable deflection limit from span, use and declared criterion.
foundation_operations.valid_example: explicit total-deflection criterion returns its limit in mm
foundation_operations.non_success_example: ambiguous bare span returns rejected_input and INPUT.CONFLICT

foundation_operations.purpose: Resolve the applicable crack-width limit from exposure and declared requirement.
foundation_operations.valid_example: declared exposure/profile returns limit and code-data revision
foundation_operations.non_success_example: conflicting project and supplied limits return rejected_input until precedence is explicit

operations.name: NormalizeActionSnapshot
operations.purpose: Convert a declared source snapshot into unit-normalized, signed, concurrent action rows while preserving source identity.
operations.valid_example: six ETABS components in kN and kNm become common action rows with unchanged concurrency
operations.non_success_example: component arrays of unequal length return rejected_input and no partial snapshot

operations.name: SolveBeamLine
operations.purpose: Solve one bounded planar elastic beam-line profile.
operations.valid_example: simply supported UDL model returns reactions, stations, actions and deflection
operations.non_success_example: unstable topology returns rejected_input with stability diagnostics

operations.name: EvaluateReinforcementGeometry
operations.purpose: Evaluate actual steel areas, centroids, effective depths, cover, spacing and geometric fit.
operations.valid_example: two-layer top and bottom arrangements return coordinates and governing clear spacing
operations.non_success_example: overlapping bars complete with engineering fail and location diagnostics

operations.name: CalculateConstructionQuantities
operations.purpose: Calculate steel, concrete, formwork, waste and optional direct cost from resolved detail data.
operations.valid_example: resolved bar paths/contact faces return reconciled quantities and priced scope
operations.non_success_example: area-only required steel returns rejected_input because no fabrication path exists

operations.name: RankEvaluatedCandidates
operations.purpose: Filter and deterministically rank already evaluated candidates for one fixed analysis revision.
operations.valid_example: two complete feasible candidates are ordered by declared objectives and tie breakers
operations.non_success_example: a candidate with a required not_applicable check is excluded as incomplete for the selected profile

operations.name: CheckFlexure
operations.purpose: Check both relevant bending signs for supported rectangular and eligible flanged sections using actual reinforcement.
operations.valid_example: negative support moment checks the physical top arrangement and reports demand/capacity
operations.non_success_example: unsupported axial interaction returns not_applicable and cannot pass the member

operations.name: CheckShear
operations.purpose: Check supported shear axes, concrete contribution, limits and actual transverse reinforcement.
operations.valid_example: stationwise demand and actual two-leg links return governing utilization
operations.non_success_example: missing provided-link geometry returns not_evaluated for a required supplied-member check

operations.name: CheckTorsion
operations.purpose: Check concurrent torsion, shear and flexure and the resulting longitudinal/perimeter reinforcement.
operations.valid_example: one concurrent action row returns equivalent actions and both reinforcement checks
operations.non_success_example: component-only envelope is rejected for an interaction requiring concurrency

operations.name: CheckDeflection
operations.purpose: Check screening or calculated short/long-term deflection for an explicit service basis.
operations.valid_example: declared sustained/transient service combinations return component and total deflections
operations.non_success_example: missing load duration leaves a required calculated check not_evaluated

operations.name: CheckCrackWidth
operations.purpose: Calculate and check crack width from service action and actual bar geometry.
operations.valid_example: service action and resolved tension bars return crack width and limit
operations.non_success_example: required check with only required steel area remains not_evaluated

operations.name: CheckAnchorage
operations.purpose: Compare required and available development at actual bar ends, supports and discontinuities.
operations.valid_example: resolved support face and hook path return available length and governing deficit
operations.non_success_example: centreline span without support-face geometry returns rejected_input

operations.name: CheckLapsAndCurtailment
operations.purpose: Check lap zones and bar termination against demand, extension and continuity rules.
operations.valid_example: resolved bar marks and station envelope return each termination decision
operations.non_success_example: unidentified governing demand revision returns stale/unbound rather than pass

operations.name: CheckSeismicDetailing
operations.purpose: Check the selected seismic member, joint and capacity-design context against actual detail.
operations.valid_example: supported frame context returns continuity, confinement, lap and capacity-design checks
operations.non_success_example: geometry-only input returns not_evaluated for missing system/joint context

operations.name: CreateBeamProject
operations.purpose: Create a versioned project with units, code data, catalogues, criteria and required-check profile.
operations.valid_example: complete project basis returns immutable project and criteria revisions
operations.non_success_example: conflicting default/material values return field diagnostics without a project

operations.name: DefineBeamTopology
operations.purpose: Define physical supports, spans, analysis elements, section regions and their mappings.
operations.valid_example: two-span beam maps support faces, centrelines, clear/effective spans and analysis nodes
operations.non_success_example: overlapping physical spans return rejected_input

operations.name: ImportEtabsSnapshot
operations.purpose: Acquire and persist an immutable ETABS model, mapping and force snapshot after preflight.
operations.valid_example: supported current model produces raw artifact, acquisition, model and analysis identities
operations.non_success_example: stale analysis returns not_run until the user authorizes analysis

operations.name: DesignMember
operations.purpose: Design or check a complete member through every required strength, serviceability, detail and fit operation.
operations.valid_example: multi-span member returns required and selected reinforcement, leaf checks and aggregate qualification
operations.non_success_example: one required unevaluated SLS check makes the member partial and not qualified

operations.name: ResolveBarPaths
operations.purpose: Resolve constructible longitudinal, side, torsion and transverse bar paths and marks.
operations.valid_example: member demand and catalogues produce exact paths, layers, hooks and marks
operations.non_success_example: no feasible layer arrangement returns engineering fail with congestion diagnostics

operations.name: CreateBarBendingSchedule
operations.purpose: Create fabrication and cutting schedules from a current resolved reinforcement revision.
operations.valid_example: resolved marks return shapes, cut lengths, counts, mass and stock plan
operations.non_success_example: stale detail revision returns stale and no issue-ready schedule

operations.name: EstimateConstructionCost
operations.purpose: Apply dated rates and scope rules to resolved quantities.
operations.valid_example: current BBS, formwork faces, concrete volumes and rates return itemized direct cost
operations.non_success_example: rate without currency/date/geography is rejected rather than silently applied

operations.name: OptimizeBeam
operations.purpose: Generate, fully evaluate and rank constructible alternatives with declared search completeness.
operations.valid_example: finite search completes and returns feasible frontier, exclusions and selected candidate
operations.non_success_example: cancelled search returns explored domain and incomplete status without claiming optimum

operations.name: ApplyCandidateToEtabsCopy
operations.purpose: Apply one selected candidate to an identified model copy, reanalyse when required and compare results.
operations.valid_example: section/stiffness change creates a copy, new analysis revision and comparison receipt
operations.non_success_example: source model revision mismatch rejects before mutation

operations.name: CalculateWorkbook
operations.purpose: Validate input tables, run bulk library calculations and write result tables with freshness.
operations.valid_example: valid standalone beam table writes current values/checks/design summary and diagnostics
operations.non_success_example: one invalid row is reported by row/field while no stale result is shown as current

operations.name: CreateCalculationPackage
operations.purpose: Create a reusable calculation-record model and adapter-rendered report, drawing and schedule package.
operations.valid_example: approved current results render a traceable package with source and limitations
operations.non_success_example: missing required leaf result yields a partial draft package, never an approved issue

operations.name: MeasureWorkbookPerformance
operations.purpose: Measure installed Excel/XLL latency and scaling against versioned workloads.
operations.valid_example: identified machine, XLL and workbook report warm/cold samples and percentiles
operations.non_success_example: in-process unit timing alone returns insufficient_evidence for the workbook class

operations.name: CheckReinforcementArrangement
operations.purpose: Check all bars, layers, covers, spacing, link enclosure, transitions and construction fit together.
operations.valid_example: full support and span arrangements pass every required geometric rule
operations.non_success_example: checking only the tension layer remains partial and cannot qualify issued detail

public_api_levels.meaning: calculate one physical or code value; does not compare demand or select a design
calculate resistance/applicability for supplied geometry and material; does not declare a demand check
compare declared demand and supplied condition; returns independent result-state dimensions
generate or select a supplied condition, then evaluate every required check
orchestrate explicit operations across stations/spans without hiding leaf results
perform application I/O or mutation outside worksheet recalculation and engineering kernels
record a qualified human action bound to exact result/detail identities; never calculated

rules: reject unknown fields at a strict typed boundary
each field declares semantic quantity, unit, obligation, condition and validation
a caller may request an approved profile default but cannot request an unnamed automatic default

deliverables.failure_contract: Expected invalid, unsupported, inapplicable, incomplete, stale and engineering-fail outcomes use the result envelope. Language exceptions are reserved for programmer misuse or unexpected infrastructure failure and are translated at adapter boundaries.

rules: keyword-only parameters after the main request/value
frozen dataclasses or equivalent immutable domain records
typed enums instead of free text
explicit unit suffixes for scalar conveniences
Result records for expected non-success outcomes
examples: design_member(request: MemberDesignRequest, *, cancellation: CancellationToken | None = None) -> MemberDesignResult

rules: PascalCase public types/methods and camelCase parameters
immutable sealed records for transport/domain values
async only for I/O, application calls or long cooperative workflows
Result records for expected non-success outcomes
examples: Task<MemberDesignResult> DesignMemberAsync(MemberDesignRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

cross_language_rules: Python and .NET names may be idiomatic projections, but both publish the same operation_semantic_id and schema version.
Equivalent canonical effective inputs, profile and code-data revision must produce equivalent semantic state and values within PF7 tolerances.
Positional convenience overloads cannot introduce a different default or meaning.
Excel functions and commands are additional projections defined in PF8, not a third engineering implementation.
deliverables.compatibility: Published recoverable names may wrap one normative operation, emit a structured compatibility diagnostic and expose the effective translation. A wrapper cannot preserve an unsafe or ambiguous result silently.

records.meaning: required or conditionally required input is absent
explicit null is not permitted for this field
blank application value cannot resolve the typed field
NaN or infinity is present
value is outside its declared numerical/domain range
authoritative inputs disagree without a precedence rule
unit cannot be converted to the normative quantity
source axes or physical face mapping is incomplete
operation requires concurrent components but received an incompatible envelope
input lies outside the selected supported profile
a proven applicability rule excludes the leaf check
a required check has no qualified outcome
source/model/analysis identity is not current
result dependencies differ from the active state
candidate domain was only partly explored
required application/runtime/version is unavailable
identified application call failed or returned inconsistent data
schema, semantic operation, profile or code-data version cannot be negotiated
a legacy name/value was explicitly translated
unexpected implementation or infrastructure failure
qualified human approval is not recorded for the exact result scope

deliverables.message_rule: Messages explain the concrete field/location and recovery; callers branch on code and state, never message text.

deliverables.trace_rule: A range is inclusive. PF11 expands ranges to operation-by-operation implementation and assurance traceability.

exit_evidence.criterion: Every operation has valid and non-success examples.
evidence: PF5-D1 defines examples for FO01-FO08 and every AO01-AO26 operation.

exit_evidence.criterion: Capacity, check, design and approval remain distinct.
evidence: PF5-D2 defines seven public levels; approval is a human record and capacity never implies a demand check.

exit_evidence.criterion: Equivalent effective inputs yield equivalent semantic outcomes.
evidence: PF5-D3 binds idiomatic projections to common semantic IDs, effective inputs, code data, states and PF7 tolerances.
